```{r}
# Part B-1. COVID-19 사망자 예측
# UK daily COVID-19 deaths: 2020-03-07 ~ 2020-08-31

library(readr)

# 1. 데이터 불러오기 및 전처리
raw <- read_csv("UK_Covid19.csv")

Covid19 <- data.frame(
  Day = as.Date(raw$Day),
  S = raw$`Daily new confirmed deaths due to COVID-19`
)

Covid19$Y <- cumsum(Covid19$S)
Covid19$Ylag <- c(0, Covid19$Y[-nrow(Covid19)])
Covid19$t <- 1:nrow(Covid19)

latest_m <- tail(Covid19$Y, 1)
latest_m


# 2. 시계열 그래프

# 일일 신규 사망자 수
plot(Covid19$Day, Covid19$S, type = "l", xaxt = "n",
     xlab = "Date", ylab = "S(t)",
     main = "UK Daily New COVID-19 Deaths")

axis.Date(1,
          at = seq(min(Covid19$Day), max(Covid19$Day), by = "1 month"),
          format = "%b")


# 누적 사망자 수
plot(Covid19$Day, Covid19$Y, type = "l", xaxt = "n",
     xlab = "Date", ylab = "Y(t)",
     main = "UK Cumulative COVID-19 Deaths")

axis.Date(1,
          at = seq(min(Covid19$Day), max(Covid19$Day), by = "1 month"),
          format = "%b")


# 3. OLS: Bass / Logistic / Gumbel
get_est <- function(n) {

  d <- Covid19[1:n, ]

  # Bass
  # S_t = a + bY_(t-1) + cY_(t-1)^2 + e_t
  # a = pm, b = q-p, c = -q/m
  fit_bass <- lm(S ~ Ylag + I(Ylag^2), data = d)

  a <- unname(coef(fit_bass)[1])
  b <- unname(coef(fit_bass)[2])
  c <- unname(coef(fit_bass)[3])

  p <- (-b + sqrt(b^2 - 4*a*c)) / 2
  q <- b + p
  m <- a / p
  
  d <- Covid19[2:n, ]

  # Logistic
  # S_t / Y_(t-1) = a + bY_(t-1) + e_t
  # a = q, b = -q/m
  fit_logistic <- lm(I(S / Ylag) ~ Ylag, data = d)

  a_log <- unname(coef(fit_logistic)[1])
  b_log <- unname(coef(fit_logistic)[2])

  q_log <- a_log
  m_log <- -a_log / b_log

  # Gumbel
  # S_t / Y_(t-1) = a + b log(Y_(t-1)) + e_t
  # a = q log(m), b = -q
  fit_gumbel <- lm(I(S / Ylag) ~ log(Ylag), data = d)

  a_gum <- unname(coef(fit_gumbel)[1])
  b_gum <- unname(coef(fit_gumbel)[2])

  q_gum <- -b_gum
  m_gum <- exp(a_gum / q_gum)

  result <- matrix(
    c(p, q, m,
      NA, q_log, m_log,
      NA, q_gum, m_gum),
    nrow = 3, byrow = TRUE
  )

  rownames(result) <- c("Bass", "Logistic", "Gumbel")
  colnames(result) <- c("p", "q", "m")

  return(result)
}


# 4. n = 20, 30, 50 추정
est20 <- get_est(20)
est30 <- get_est(30)
est50 <- get_est(50)

est20
est30
est50


# 5. 상대오차 계산
# 상대오차(%) = 100 * (추정 m - 실제 최신 누적값) / 실제 최신 누적값
calc_error <- function(est) {
  100 * (est[, "m"] - latest_m) / latest_m
}

error20 <- calc_error(est20)
error30 <- calc_error(est30)
error50 <- calc_error(est50)

error20
error30
error50


# 6. 결과표
result_20 <- data.frame(
  Model = rownames(est20),
  p = est20[, "p"],
  q = est20[, "q"],
  m = est20[, "m"],
  Relative_Error = error20
)

result_30 <- data.frame(
  Model = rownames(est30),
  p = est30[, "p"],
  q = est30[, "q"],
  m = est30[, "m"],
  Relative_Error = error30
)

result_50 <- data.frame(
  Model = rownames(est50),
  p = est50[, "p"],
  q = est50[, "q"],
  m = est50[, "m"],
  Relative_Error = error50
)

result_20
result_30
result_50


# 7. Gumbel OLS 결과
gumbel_ols <- data.frame(
  n = c(20, 30, 50),
  q = c(est20["Gumbel", "q"],
        est30["Gumbel", "q"],
        est50["Gumbel", "q"]),
  m = c(est20["Gumbel", "m"],
        est30["Gumbel", "m"],
        est50["Gumbel", "m"])
)

gumbel_ols


# 8. NLSE
gumbel_nls <- function(n, start_m, start_q, start_mu) {

  d <- Covid19[1:n, ]

  fit <- nls(
    S ~ m * (
      exp(-exp(-q * (t - mu))) -
      exp(-exp(-q * (t - 1 - mu)))
    ),
    data = d,
    start = list(
      m = start_m,
      q = start_q,
      mu = start_mu
    ),
    algorithm = "port",
    lower = c(m = 0.000001, q = 0.000001, mu = -Inf),
    upper = c(m = 1000000, q = 10, mu = Inf)
  )

  coef(fit)
}


# 9. MLE
# Gumbel CDF
gumbel_F <- function(t, q, mu) {
  exp(-exp(-q * (t - mu)))
}

gumbel_mle <- function(n, start_m, start_q, start_mu) {

  d <- Covid19[1:n, ]
  t <- d$t

  loglik <- function(par) {

    m <- exp(par[1])
    q <- exp(par[2])
    mu <- par[3]

    F_t <- gumbel_F(t, q, mu)
    F_prev <- gumbel_F(t - 1, q, mu)

    lambda <- m * (F_t - F_prev)

    if (any(lambda <= 0) || any(!is.finite(lambda))) {
      return(1e100)
    }

    -sum(dpois(d$S, lambda = lambda, log = TRUE))
  }

  fit <- optim(
    par = c(log(start_m), log(start_q), start_mu),
    fn = loglik,
    method = "L-BFGS-B",
    lower = c(log(1), log(0.000001), -100),
    upper = c(log(1000000), log(10), 100)
  )

  c(
    m = exp(fit$par[1]),
    q = exp(fit$par[2]),
    mu = fit$par[3]
  )
}


# 10. n = 20, 30, 50 추정
# OLS 결과를 초기값으로 사용

nlse_result <- data.frame(
  n = gumbel_ols$n,
  m = NA,
  q = NA,
  mu = NA
)

mle_result <- data.frame(
  n = gumbel_ols$n,
  m = NA,
  q = NA,
  mu = NA
)

for (i in 1:nrow(gumbel_ols)) {
  
  n <- gumbel_ols$n[i]
  m <- gumbel_ols$m[i]
  q <- gumbel_ols$q[i]
  
  # mu 초기값 계산
  mu <- n + log(-log(Covid19$Y[n] / m)) / q
  
  # NLSE
  nlse <- gumbel_nls(n, m, q, mu)
  
  nlse_result[i, "m"] <- nlse["m"]
  nlse_result[i, "q"] <- nlse["q"]
  nlse_result[i, "mu"] <- nlse["mu"]
  
  # MLE
  mle <- gumbel_mle(n, m, q, mu)
  
  mle_result[i, "m"] <- mle["m"]
  mle_result[i, "q"] <- mle["q"]
  mle_result[i, "mu"] <- mle["mu"]
}

nlse_result
mle_result


# 11. OLS / NLSE / MLE 결과 정리
comparison <- data.frame(
  n = gumbel_ols$n,
  OLS = gumbel_ols$m,
  NLSE = nlse_result$m,
  MLE = mle_result$m
)

comparison


# 12. 추정방법별 상대오차
relative_error <- data.frame(
  n = gumbel_ols$n,
  
  OLS = 100 * (gumbel_ols$m - latest_m) / latest_m,
  NLSE = 100 * (nlse_result$m - latest_m) / latest_m,
  MLE = 100 * (mle_result$m - latest_m) / latest_m
)

relative_error
```
